processing_notes: Source indicates sporadic pattern 1975-1977 and resumed activity 1979. Year 1978 not mentioned in annual data. IMPORTANT: Mozambique's Health Information System was established 1976 and MoH surveillance mechanism only fully operational from 1979. 1978 absence may be surveillance system gap rather than true zero transmission. Evidence type: Documented_Absence - formal data collection system not yet fully operational. Confidence 0.6. [AGENT 1 REVISION 2026-10-02] NEW EVIDENCE (same source, metadata 2, Aragon et al. Rev Saude Publica 1994;28(5), Tabela 1 'Taxa de incidencia/100.000 hab. e letalidade da colera. Mocambique, 1973-1992', Fonte: Boletim Epidemiologico Semanal (BES) DNS, Ministerio da Saude): the table DOES list 1978, with 'Taxa de Incidencia 0,0 / Taxa de Letalidade 0,0', between 1977 (0,2 / 16,7) and 1979 (7,9 / 12,1). Text: 'De 1975 a 1977 apareceram alguns casos esporadicos, num total de 29 ... A partir de 1979 a doenca ocorre praticamente sem interrupcao ate 1984.' The national BES recorded the 29 sporadic cases of 1975-1977 (incidence 0,03-0,2/100,000), so it could detect single cases in this era; it recorded none in 1978. The earlier statement in this note that 1978 is 'not mentioned in annual data' is incorrect. Re-labelled from Surveillance_Gap (prohibited for zero rows) to Documented_Absence; surveillance status: partial (BES, bacteriologically-confirmed case definition 1973-1990). Caveat: no 1978 row exists in ./data/MOZ/cholera_data_jhu.csv to cross-check. Confidence 0.8. (reason: Agent 1 Batch 1 Q14: Aragon 1994 Tabela 1 (image read from SciELO) documents 0.0 incidence for 1978)
